maria (eng-ml): heads up — seeing a ~6% drop in span coverage for Payments ETL after the 2.1 deploy at 02:10 UTC. looks like missing child spans in aggregator. not sure if it's the same rootcause but pattern matches the last few incidents.

kevin (eng-sre): on it. can you paste a quick log sample? also which customer cohorts are affected?

maria (eng-ml): sample from the aggregator host attached below — truncated. error looks like prefix merge skipped keys for sequences > 1024.
```
2026-03-22T02:12:34Z agg-01 INFO merging batch id=0x7f seq=1050 dropped_children=17
2026-03-22T02:12:34Z agg-01 WARN missing kv for key=trace:12345 span_count=3
```

remedy-bot: incident created: INC-2026-331. priority=P2. linked to postmortem queue. :robot_face:

joan (observability): thanks. can we treat this as recurring-pattern candidate? i've seen similar missing-kv warnings on 2026-02-10 and 2026-01-18. putting a short filter on the observability board.

sam (product): what impact are we seeing in downstream metrics? any customer-facing errors?

maria (eng-ml): no customer errors surfaced yet — just analytics/coverage gaps. core metrics (token counts per trace) off by ~4-8% for Payments during the window.

kevin (eng-sre): quick mitigation: revert aggregator config `merge_batch_size` to 512 and redeploy to canary group. command: `env MERGE_BATCH_SIZE=512 ./deploy.sh canary` — should stop the skipped prefix path until we patch. assigning to me for the hotfix. owner: @kevin, ETA 6h for canary, 24h for global.

maria (eng-ml): i'll add a regression test in the ETL-e2e suite to simulate long sequences and catch skipped-kv behavior. owner: @maria, ETA 48h. i'll also add a metric `aggregator.dropped_children.count` and an alert if >5/min.

joan (observability): please add the new alert to the postmortem follow-ups board and link to the 3 prior incidents. i'll take care of the recurring-pattern doc and try to find commonalities (sequence length, peak qps windows, quantization changes). owner: @joan, ETA 72h.

sam (product): good. can we get a short timeline for customers ops? i'd like a 1-paragraph summary for the weekly ops sync.

kevin (eng-sre): timeline: 02:10 UTC — deploy 2.1, 02:12-02:20 — coverage drop, 02:30 — canary revert queued, 03:05 — canary healthy, 04:00 — global roll. i'll post a short incident note once rollout is done.

maria (eng-ml): adding repro steps to the ticket: feed long-running trace with >1024 tokens into agg locally, run `./agg --merge-check --verbose` and observe `missing kv` warnings. will attach script.

joan (observability): small ask: can we tag all related incidents with `recurrence:span-drop` in the tracker so it's easier to query patterns?

kevin (eng-sre): done — tagged INC-2026-331 + linked the older ones.

maria (eng-ml): one more note — looks like quantization upgrade in 2.1 changed key hashing a bit; i'll coordinate with infra to validate compatibility. might be the underlying trigger.

sam (product): thanks everyone. can we reconvene tomorrow 10:00am PST for a short root-cause sync? please have owners update the follow-up board before then. :calendar:

kevin (eng-sre): ack.

joan (observability): ack — i'll bring initial recurrence analysis.

maria (eng-ml): ack — will have repro + regression test ready.

remedy-bot: INC-2026-331 status updated -> monitoring.
